subject: Renewal + Dedicated Expansion: co-term PO amendment for additional GPU pools
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@datashift.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Elena Morris <elena.morris@datashift.ai>
Date: 2026-02-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal window — add reserved GPUs & co-term with upcoming renewal

Hi Marissa / Elena,

We hit our internal capacity planning last week and would like to expand our Dedicated footprint with Redwood as part of the upcoming renewal (term rolls on 2026-03-01). Specifically we want to add: 8x A100 reserved GPUs (single dedicated pool), with a baseline throughput commitment for our LLM inference workloads.

Ask: can we co-term this expansion with our existing contract renewal (so the additional capacity follows the same renewal date) and amend the current PO rather than doing a separate contract? Procurement preference is quarterly invoicing for the added capacity (rather than a lump upfront).

Requirements/notes:
- Target steady-state throughput: ~300 tokens/sec aggregated for two production models (peak 450 tokens/sec).
- Minimum reserved instances available: 4 GPU-equivalents to guarantee burst capacity.
- We need an amendment/PO change + updated invoice schedule and a revised SOW that calls out throughput guarantees and fallbacks.

I attached our internal procurement note (we'll share a PO number once legal confirms). Let me know the next steps and if you need additional detail from our infra team.

Thanks,
Samir
Director of ML Ops, DataShift
attachments: Datashift_capacity_request.pdf (pdf)

Thanks Samir — glad you surfaced this ahead of the renewal. We can absolutely co-term the expansion so the added capacity aligns with your 2026-03-01 renewal date.

Planned next steps (proposed timeline):
- Today: I’ll loop in our SE & infra leads to size the pool and confirm throughput guarantees (cc'd: Rishi).
- 2/3–2/5: SE sends throughput estimates + a short SOW addendum.
- 2/6–2/9: Legal & Finance prepare a PO amendment that co-terms with the renewal and outlines invoice schedule options (quarterly or annual).
- 2/10: We share an updated PO amendment and SOW for your review; you provide PO number and preferred billing cadence.

For procurement: co-terming is straightforward — we’ll issue an amendment that appends to your existing contract and marks the new capacity as effective immediately upon signature but with the same contract end date (3/01/2027 if you renew for 12 months). We can also prorate the first invoice for the partial period if you prefer quarterly billing.

Looping in Rishi to confirm the recommended config and whether we should suggest any throughput SLAs or throttling fallbacks. Vivek will help with pricing and reserve-pool options. Dev — please standby for PO amendment language.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi all — I attached an estimate (throughput_estimate_rishi.xlsx) and a short SOW addendum draft. High level notes: 

Recommended configuration:
- Dedicated pool: 8x A100 GPUs (single pool)
- Minimum guaranteed capacity: equivalent to 4 GPUs reserved (ensures baseline throughput)
- Autoscaling: allow burst to remaining GPUs within pool up to 8 when available

Throughput guidance (dependent on model/seq length):
- Baseline per-A100: ~35–45 tokens/sec for model A (FP16, standard batch sizes)
- Aggregate steady state: expect 280–360 tokens/sec for your two-production-model mix; peaks up to ~480 tokens/sec for short sequences with aggressive batching

SLAs & fallbacks:
- We can include a throughput SLO: target 95th percentile steady-state throughput >= 250 tokens/sec. If we miss SLO for two consecutive weeks, automatic mitigation will include temporary burst allocation (if capacity available) and a credit schedule defined in the amendment.

Operational items to include in SOW addendum:
- KV-prefix caching expectations
- Model quantization guidance (recommended INT8 where acceptable) to reduce cost/latency
- Monitoring hooks and alerting thresholds (we’ll surface token-level cost per route)

I attached the spreadsheet with model assumptions and the draft SOW addendum (SOW-dedicated-addendum.docx as a wording stub). Happy to jump on a 30-min call with your infra team if you want to validate peak patterns.

—Rishi
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: throughput_estimate_rishi.xlsx (xlsx), SOW-dedicated-addendum.docx (docx)

Hi Elena / Marissa,

Attached is our redlined PO amendment (DataShift_PO_Amendment_v2.pdf) and a tracked SOW addendum. Key legal/finance points we adjusted: 

1) Co-term language: amendment explicitly states the new capacity is added to the existing agreement and that the contract end date mirrors the existing renewal (2027-03-01 if a 12-month renewal is elected).
2) Billing schedule: clause 4 updated to allow quarterly invoicing; first invoice prorated from the effective date to the next quarter boundary. We proposed specific invoice dates: 03/15/2026 (prorated), 06/15/2026, 09/15/2026, 12/15/2026, etc.
3) SLA / credits: clarified credit calculation for missed throughput SLOs (percentage credit tied to missed-week aggregates) and a 30-day remediation period before crediting.
4) Data & security: added reference to existing SOC 2 evidence and that no model weights or customer data is exported; included audit log retention requirement per your request.

Please confirm PO number (DS-2026-1175) and whether quarterly invoicing works. Once confirmed we’ll generate a DocuSign packet for signature and schedule capacity provisioning for 3/8–3/10.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
